1.title: Michigan Rabbis Press El-Sayed to Change Tone and Stance on Israel
1.summary: A coalition of Jewish leaders is launching a petition drive aimed at the Democratic Senate nominee, a fresh indicator of frictions in a key battleground.

2.title: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
2.summary: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport.

3.title: A.I. Models Built a Computer Worm That Could Rapidly Hack WeChat Accounts
3.summary: The attack, discovered by A.I. researchers, could have compromised hundreds of millions of devices within hours, experts said.

4.title: Investigation after female staff at Eiffel Tower replaced by men for religious visit
4.summary: The move saw outraged staff walk off the job on Monday, closing the French landmark for a day.

5.title: Saudi Arabia Vows Retaliation After Houthi Attacks Injure Dozens
5.summary: The latest escalation threatens to drag Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi militia back into a full-blown war.

6.title: Russia Bombards Kyiv Soon After Witkoff, Kushner Leave
6.summary: Russia agreed not to bomb Ukraine’s capital during Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner’s visit there. The respite was short-lived.
